Package alice.tuplecentre

Interface Summary
AgentId Represents an agent identifier It's used inside tuple centre to identify an agent interacting with the medium.
ObservableEventListener Defines listeners of tuple centre virtual machine observable events (actually inspectors)
OutputEventListener Defines the services that must be provided by any object which must receive commounication output events produced by a tuple centre
Reaction Represents the reaction concept of tuple centre model.
Tuple Defines the information content of tuple centre and exchanged thorugh interactions.
TupleCentreId Represents identifier for a tuple centre
TupleTemplate Defines the template used to retrieve tuple information from Tuple Centres, thorugh interactions.
 

Class Summary
Event Represents events of the tuple centre virtual machine According to the tuple centre model, an event is characterised by the operation that caused the event, the direction of the event (from agent to the tuple centre, or viceversa), the identification of the agent related to the operation.
InputEvent Represents input events of the tuple centre virtual machine
InputEvent_getSpec This class represents getSpec communication input events of the VM
InputEvent_in This class represents in communication input events of the VM
InputEvent_inp This class represents inp communication input events of the VM
InputEvent_out This class represents out communication input events of the VM
InputEvent_rd This class represents rd communication input events of the VM
InputEvent_rdp This class represents rdp communication input events of the VM
InputEvent_setSpec This class represents setSpec communication input events of the VM
ObservableEvent Represents observable (by inspectors) events happening inside tuple centre virtual machine
OutputEvent Represents output events of the tuple centre virtual machine
OutputEvent_getSpec Represents output event produced as answer to a getSpec input event
OutputEvent_in Represents output event produced as answer to a in input event
OutputEvent_inp Represents output event produced as answer to a inp input event
OutputEvent_rd Represents output event produced as answer to a rdp input event
OutputEvent_rdp Represents output event produced as answer to a rdp input event
OutputEvent_setSpec Represents output events related to setSpec input events of the tuple centre virtual machine
OutputEventListenerActionInfo  
PendingQueryEvent Represents pending query input events of the tuple centre virtual machine
TriggeredReaction Represents a reaction which has been triggered inside a tuple centre by a specific event
TupleCentreVM Defines the core behaviour of a tuple centre virtual machine.
 

Exception Summary
InvalidTupleException This exception is thrown when a not well-formed tuple is found, for instance when invoking a coordination language primitive with a null tuple.
